meta.howToAlign: Run Whisper on the narration mp3 (e.g. @remotion/install-whisper-cpp + @remotion/captions), strip ElevenLabs tags like [softly]/[excited] from any text comparison, then for each cue find alignPhrase in the word timestamps and overwrite startSec/startFrame. If the voice is regenerated, redo the alignment.

globalRules: Single <Audio> track: the already-mixed file. Do not add other music.
Persistent animated background: dark navy knowledge graph (~60 nodes, seeded layout, slow drift) present in every scene; its state changes per cue (see 'background').
Signature transition 'dive' = zoom + slight blur (~12 frames); reuse it, do not invent new ones except the special ones marked in the cues.
Screens: ONLY real screen recordings inside a rounded frame (soft shadow, subtle 3D tilt, spring() entry). Never recreate or fake UI, Raya answers, or numbers.
Captions: word-by-word, generated from the audio, keywords highlighted.
Show 'Illustrative example · Demo data' at the start and on teacher screens.
Recording file names are placeholders; map them to the real files.

backgroundStates.graph_gray: all nodes gray, very low contrast
backgroundStates.graph_gray_crack: gray graph, algebra node cracked, fracture line toward physics
backgroundStates.graph_soft: graph at low opacity behind the frame
backgroundStates.graph_path_lit: glowing path from algebra node to physics node
backgroundStates.graph_class_wide: zoomed out, dozens of nodes lit (the class)
backgroundStates.graph_same_node_lit: same red node as the student scene lit
backgroundStates.graph_two_nodes_linked: two red nodes linked by a glowing line

cues.alignPhrase: Hi everyone, and welcome to Bluestift

transitionIn.notes: Two crossing orbit rings (blue + orange) around the logo, graph gray behind.

cues.alignPhrase: Meet a student

transitionIn.notes: Orbits dissolve into the gray graph.

overlays: nodeFlash: physics node flashes red once on 'She fails physics. Again.'

cues.alignPhrase: she missed one key idea in algebra

transitionIn.notes: An algebra node cracks; a thin fracture line climbs toward the physics node. Nothing else on screen.

cues.alignPhrase: That's the kind of problem Bluestift is built to catch

transitionIn.notes: Graph dims, logo breathes, then dive into the graph.

cues.alignPhrase: So she asks Raya for help

transitionIn.notes: Rounded frame with soft shadow and subtle 3D tilt enters with spring().

overlays: optional tags Ask / Hint / Reveal synced to 'asks what she would try first', 'offers a hint', 'reveals the missing piece' (labels only, never fake UI)

cues.alignPhrase: Luckily, she doesn't have to leave

transitionIn.notes: SAME frame stays; content crossfades from chat to Study Room (she does not leave Raya).

cues.alignPhrase: Then a notification pops up

transitionIn.notes: Notification toast pops in top-right, then expands into the analysis page (shared element).

cues.alignPhrase: The root cause is a gap in algebra

transitionIn.notes: KEY MOMENT: zoom on the red algebra bar/node, dim background, node pulses once, glowing path climbs in the background graph from algebra to physics. Hold the diagnosis sentence ~3 s.

cues.alignPhrase: this time the physics problem clicks

transitionIn.notes: Back to Raya. Physics node turns green in the background graph.

cues.alignPhrase: in Tools Studio

transitionIn.notes: Frame slides up to Tools Studio. On 'a lesson, a PDF, notes, even a voice memo' four small file icons pop in around the frame, word by word.

cues.alignPhrase: Meanwhile, in the classroom

transitionIn.notes: SPECIAL: student analysis card scales up, blurs, morphs into the teacher alert card. Background graph zooms OUT and lights dozens of nodes (the class).

cues.alignPhrase: she doesn't have to guess where to begin

transitionIn.notes: Teacher overview. Alert badges pulse once.

cues.alignPhrase: She filters for students who may need support

transitionIn.notes: Zoom on the 'needs watching' filter, then the student profile slides in. Highlight the red 'Leaning on answers' badge on 'relying on answers'.

cues.alignPhrase: One red node stands out

transitionIn.notes: Zoom on the red node in the student's graph, halo. The SAME node lights up in the background graph to echo the student scene.

cues.alignPhrase: join her students in their Study Rooms
cues.source: scene_teacher_rooms.mp4 then scene_teacher_instructions.mp4 (TODO: instructions-to-Raya screen not yet provided)

transitionIn.notes: Two quick beats: Study Room (crossfade), then 'guide Raya' instructions screen.

cues.alignPhrase: never the student's private conversations

transitionIn.notes: Lock icon + the words 'Mastery only' appear for ~2 s.

cues.alignPhrase: She leaves a note for the class team

transitionIn.notes: Zoom on 'Add a note', the note is added. Hold ~1 s on 'Now she knows where to start.'

cues.alignPhrase: One student. One teacher

transitionIn.notes: Split screen: student view left, teacher view right, a glowing line links the two red nodes.

cues.alignPhrase: That's Bluestift

transitionIn.notes: Both frames shrink into the logo; background nodes regroup around it.

cues.alignPhrase: We diagnose first

transitionIn.notes: Large, sober text: 'We diagnose first. The learning follows.'

cues.alignPhrase: live at thebluestift.com

transitionIn.notes: URL appears and stays until the end of the voice + 3 s music tail, then fade to black.
